subjects.name: Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude
subjects.description: Arithmetic, algebra, and quantitative techniques for central & state exams.

topics.name: Percentages
topics.description: Fraction to percentage conversions, percentage increase/decrease, successive changes.

topics.name: Ratio and Proportion
topics.description: Direct and inverse ratios, mean proportional, duplicate ratios, division of amounts.

topics.name: Time and Work
topics.description: Efficiency method, LCM method, working together and alternate days.

topics.name: Number System
topics.description: Divisibility rules, unit digit cyclicity, remainder theorem, factor counts, and trailing zeros.

topics.name: Average
topics.description: Arithmetic mean, cricket batting/bowling averages, age changes, replacement, and alligation.

topics.name: Profit and Loss
topics.description: CP, SP, marked price, discounts, successive discounts, and dishonest dealer tricks.

topics.name: Simple & Compound Interest
topics.description: SI, CI compounding periods, CI-SI difference formulas, doubling rules, and installments.

topics.name: Time, Speed & Distance
topics.description: Relative velocity, trains crossing platforms/poles, boats & streams, and races.

subjects.name: General Intelligence & Reasoning
subjects.description: Logical patterns, sequences, analytical reasoning, and spatial deductions.

topics.name: Number Series
topics.description: Arithmetic, geometric, alternate differences, prime, and square series patterns.

topics.name: Blood Relations
topics.description: Family tree diagrams, coded relations, and direct pointing relationships.

topics.name: Direction Sense
topics.description: Cardinal and intercardinal compass directions, turns, angles, and shortest distance.

topics.name: Analogy
topics.description: Word, numerical square/cube pairs, letter rank transformations, and scientific unit relations.

topics.name: Coding and Decoding
topics.description: Alphabet position shifts, opposite letters, number codes, and fictitious word coding.

topics.name: Syllogism
topics.description: Venn diagram deductions, universal/particular premises, 'only a few', and possibility rules.

topics.name: Calendar and Clock
topics.description: Odd days calculation, day of historical dates, clock hand angles, and gains/losses.

subjects.name: Indian Polity & Constitution
subjects.description: Constitutional provisions, fundamental rights, parliament, governance, and landmark rulings.

topics.name: Fundamental Rights
topics.description: Articles 12-35, equality, freedoms, writs under Article 32, exceptions, and amendments.

topics.name: Parliament & Lawmaking
topics.description: Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, legislative procedure, money bills, ordinances, and committees.

topics.name: Preamble & Making of Constitution
topics.description: Constituent assembly, basic structure doctrine, key dates, borrowed features, and amendments.

topics.name: Directive Principles & Fundamental Duties
topics.description: Articles 36-51, Gandhian/Socialist/Liberal principles, Art 51A duties, and Verma committee.

topics.name: Judiciary (Supreme Court & High Courts)
topics.description: Jurisdictions (Art 32, 131, 136, 142, 143), collegium system, PIL, and landmark judgments.

topics.name: Panchayati Raj & Local Government
topics.description: 73rd Amendment, 11th Schedule, Gram Sabha, State Election & Finance commissions, and PESA.

subjects.name: General Science
subjects.description: Physics and biology fundamentals standard in railway and staff selection exams.

topics.name: Physics Fundamentals
topics.description: SI units, mechanics, Newton's laws, optics, thermodynamics, work, and electricity.

topics.name: Biology Fundamentals
topics.description: Cell structure, human physiology, vitamins and deficiency diseases, genetics, plant biology.

topics.name: Chemistry Fundamentals
topics.description: Acids, bases, pH scale, chemical formulas of salts, metals, non-metals, alloys, and catalysts.

topics.name: Environment & Ecology
topics.description: Greenhouse effect, ozone depletion, trophic 10% law, Ramsar wetlands, and pollution disasters.

subjects.name: English Language
subjects.description: Grammar, vocabulary, comprehension for SSC and state examinations.

topics.name: Error Detection
topics.description: Subject-verb agreement, subjunctive mood, correlative conjunctions, parallel structure, and tenses.

topics.name: Synonyms & Antonyms
topics.description: High-yield vocabulary pairs, contextual word meanings, and Latin/Greek root words.

topics.name: Idioms & Phrases
topics.description: Popular classical, historical, and modern English idioms and proverb meanings.

topics.name: One-Word Substitution
topics.description: Government forms (-cracy), professions, phobias, manias, and murder suffixes (-cide).

subjects.name: Computer Knowledge
subjects.description: Computer fundamentals, hardware, operating systems, and networking.

topics.name: Computer Fundamentals
topics.description: Hardware architecture, CPU, ALU, memory hierarchy, binary conversions, and generation of computers.

topics.name: Operating Systems
topics.description: Process scheduling, virtual memory, paging, deadlocks, semaphores, and kernel architectures.

topics.name: MS Office Suite
topics.description: Word shortcuts, Excel formulas (VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables), and PowerPoint features.

topics.name: Networking & Cybersecurity
topics.description: OSI 7 layers, TCP/IP, DNS, IP/MAC addressing, firewalls, phishing, and cryptography.
